candidates.part: NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X 6144-core GPU / 20-core CPU

platform_fit.decision: The 128 GB floor is retained. X2 Elite and Plus publish controller capacity for it, but HP OmniBook Ultra 14-kg000 with X2E-90-100 has documented 64 GB system memory, 64 GB below Slate's floor. The reviewed ASUS X2 Extreme has 48 GB on package; reviewed X2 Plus systems have 32 GB. A reviewed N1X laptop SKU is configured with 128 GB, but it does not establish a Slate compute package or phone integration. No reviewed public 128 GB X2 configuration or pocket phone integration is established. Obtain an orderable 128 GB package and supplier topology, power, software, and modem evidence before selection.
platform_fit.caveat: Published maximum memory and modem features do not prove a supported memory topology, purchasability, thermal fit, or a working phone.

missing_design_evidence: Selected platform UFS host support and boot compatibility
Controlled 153-ball pin map, land pattern, and assembly keepouts
Regulator selection, power sequence, decoupling, and PDN measurements
Sourcing, lifecycle, and controlled supplier acceptance
Routed signal-integrity review and physical read/write test
storage_fit.caveat: A public package outline and supply range are candidate inputs, not a selected storage design or a functional device.

battery_fit.supplier_path_finding: Enovix ended system-level AI-1 smartphone field testing with its lead OEM after the tested version no longer met that customer's energy-density requirements; development shifted toward smaller cells.
missing_design_evidence: Custom cell and complete-pack drawing within the allocation
Tab, protection, connector, insulation, and swelling allowances
Supplier charge curve and maximum current across voltage and temperature
Battery protection design, safety review, and measured charge validation
battery_fit.caveat: The published cell box and concept pack envelope both exceed the current complete-pack allocation. A custom design or approved allocation change is required; no cell or charge rate is selected.

lipol_pack_screen.caveat: The body envelope is drawing-derived, but its placement is assumed. Leads, connector, swelling, tolerances, and thermal protection need a released pack design. The PDF's 4.2 V charge limit is used over the product page's conflicting 4.48 V listing.

usb_fit.caveat: The 4 mm clear corridor is only an AABB routing screen, not a connector footprint or manufacturable flex. A full-width carrier crosses the assumed battery pack envelope. Moving the port to the PCB edge misses the modeled frame aperture. Connector mounting, flex bend and traces, pack clearance, retention, enclosure seal, PD design, and physical testing remain unresolved. Published ratings do not authorize charging.

gct_candidate_outline.caveat: Centered rectangular drawing envelope only. The mounting span includes stakes and can overstate frame interference. The 0.8 mm connector offset does not qualify the 0.8 mm board. USB 3.2 Gen 2 is not USB4. No footprint, supplier STEP, PD design, or physical fit is released.

reverse_board_extension.caveat: Whole-mm board-width search and nominal boxes only; this is not a qualified modem site, board, or phone design.

drawing_candidate.caveat: The published panel outline excludes unverified flex routing, integration allowances, and tolerance stack; the A0 document is preliminary.

obsolete_32gb_reference.caveat: This exact 32 GB part is obsolete; package capacity does not establish X2 channel/rank support or procurement.

placement_study.caveat: Planar package boxes do not include solder lands, via escape, decoupling, shields, thermal contacts, or X2 memory-channel rules.

compact_16gb_reference.caveat: Micron's catalog listing and these rectangles do not establish procurement, a supported X2 memory map, routing, thermal closure, or a booted 128 GB unit.

adata_unit_reconciliation.caveat: Organization arithmetic resolves the displayed unit mismatch; it does not establish availability, X2 qualification, channel/rank support, or a routed board.

bus_topology_screen.caveat: The width comparison only rules out one independent host connection per reference package. It cannot prove whether shared channels, ranks, timing, routing, or boot are supported.

eight_package_study.caveat: Planar package boxes do not include solder lands, via escape, decoupling, shields, thermal contacts, or X2 memory-channel rules.

missing_design_evidence: Current-production 32 GB package MPN, drawing, and availability, or a new eight-package board architecture
X2-qualified 128 GB shared-channel or other package topology, ranks, and signal rules

memory_package_fit.caveat: This 16 GB part is a public geometry reference, not an X2-qualified memory selection. Eight packages do not prove a routable or bootable 128 GB Slate board.
